name: Asahi
message: 「……Haa, I lost.」
Without any fakes or feints, my strike, which I had gambled everything on speed for, didn't reach Momiji.
If I couldn't win with that, there was nothing more I could do. Thinking that, I felt strangely refreshed.
Becoming a Toujinegi had been my dream.
To be more precise, becoming a professional Jindou athlete—

name: Takahisa
message: 「Oh—, amazing, amazing, that’s amazing！ As expected of Asahi. You can already do something like that！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Asahi is strong！ You’ll be able to become the best sword fighter in Japan someday.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yeah, I… want to be the best sword fighter in Japan. Are you going to be the best in Japan too, big brother？」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I want to become a professional Jindou athlete when I grow up. And then, I’m going to make this dojo bigger and better！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I want to be a professional athlete too.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Sounds good, then let’s both become professional Jindou athletes.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yeah, big brother!」

name: Asahi
message: 「I wonder if it was impossible for me after all……」
While I was zoning out, I got a call.

name: Asahi
message: 「……Yes, this is Asahi.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Asahi! I saw the match! You looked so cool!!」
It was my older brother calling.

name: Asahi
message: 「I’m hanging up now.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Wait—！？ Hold on, hold on, why are you hanging up all of a sudden！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Because I don’t want to hear your noisy voice, that’s why.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Don’t say that, little sister~, hey, come on, little sister~！」

name: Asahi
message: 「You’re annoying, please stop.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Hahaha, my bad, my bad.」
Even while saying that, my brother didn’t sound sorry in the slightest.

name: Takahisa
message: 「……Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「What is it.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「You've truly improved to the point of being unrecognizable. You worked so hard.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「In that match, you shone brighter than anyone else.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I felt so proud seeing you standing on that stage today, Asahi. You’re my pride and joy of a little sister」

name: Takahisa
message: 「No matter what anyone else says... Asahi, you were the best！」
Why is this?
Hearing it from my brother, tears came surging up all of a sudden.

name: Asahi
message: 「...What's so 'best' about it? I lost, you know！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Even so！ Even so, to me, you're number one！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Your hard work really came through！ It was genuinely thrilling！ You were so cool！ You were the best！！！」
...Ah, there he was.
The person who understood me was here.
Once I realized that, I couldn't hold it back anymore.

name: Asahi
message: 「Uu... *sniff*, Brother, Brother...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I wanted to win...！ I wanted to beat Momiji...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I had decided so long ago... that I would win the Martial Festival and become a Toujinegi, I always, always...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ever since I saw you come home with that injury, I told myself I would fulfill the dream you couldn't...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ever since I saw you crying behind the dojo, I had decided I would absolutely become a Toujinegi...！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Asahi, you were thinking that...」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's so frustrating, Big Brother...! I'm so, so frustrated...!」
My vision blurred, and tears spilled out one after another.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Yeah... you're right, it's frustrating, isn't it...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「This is nothing compared to the frustration you felt, I know that, uu... *sob*...！！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Asahi, you don't have to hold it in. You did so well！ You were truly amazing, Asahi...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Uuuuaaaaah, fuwaaaaaaaaaaaaah... Big Brotheeer, nnnguuuuuuuuu...!」
I cried out loud.
Without wiping away the falling tears, I looked up and wailed.
I wonder how long it's been since I cried this much—.

name: Asahi
message: 「Uuu... sniff... ah...」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Asahi, I'm sorry.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Sniff... Why are you apologizing, Brother?」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I had no idea you were aiming to become the Toujinegi for my sake, Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...I wasn't aiming to become the Toujinegi for your sake, Brother. Please don't flatter yourself.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Even so. If I became a burden on you, I feel like I really did something terrible to you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Brother...」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I really should've known that about you.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「You're so strong that you don't even cry out when you're hurt. You just endure it in silence and keep it all bottled up.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Taking on other people's pain too, carrying it all on your own. Putting on a calm face so no one ever notices.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「You're always so cold to me, you know. So I just assumed you weren't really worried about me at all.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I thought you looked down on me as a loser for getting injured and coming back without accomplishing anything.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「But there's no way that's true, is there.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I should've known better than anyone that you're not that kind of person.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「...I'm sorry I didn't notice, Asahi.」
My eyes begin to well up with tears again.

name: Takahisa
message: 「...Once the Martial Festival ends, summer break starts right away.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Hey, Asahi, come on back home for Obon.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Then, just like old times, while we eat watermelon together on the porch」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Tell me all about your matches, the academy, and yourself too... I want to hear everything.」
It was a very... tempting invitation.
So, I—

name: Asahi
message: 「Sniff... I don't want to.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Heeeey！ You've gotta be kidding me？！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「That was definitely the part where you're supposed to say 'yes', right！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Why do I have to go back home for such a tiresome event as talking to my brother?」

name: Asahi
message: 「You're just my brother, yet you're so cocky.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Seriously? Man, that hurts...」

name: Asahi
message: 「...If you want me to come back, you should ask me more passionately, like you're groveling for it.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then, I might consider it.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「You really are... geez, what an honest-to-a-fault little sister you are！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Right back at you.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Well, I guess you're right.」
The two of them share a brief laugh.

name: Takahisa
message: 「I'll be in touch again, Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Yes, I'll be waiting.」
Wiping away a stray tear, I let my mouth curl into a smile.
